detail: Discovered during planning for the human-voiced docs site (2026-08-27). Decision 01KYXA3B32ECSE7CDCJTBMN5TS extended test/plugin-tool-references to parse table rows in README.md and docs/TWINING-REFERENCE.md and assert default-vs-full-surface classification. If the new VitePress site carries its own tool tables and is not covered, the inversion bug that test was written for can silently return. Options: (a) generate the tool reference tables at docs-build time from the server's tool registry; (b) extend the test to the site's markdown. Decide at plan time. Also noted: GitHub Pages is not configured on the repo (gh api 404) — the deploy workflow will need Pages enabled with source=GitHub Actions, a repo-settings step only the owner can do.
resolution_note: Resolved by session record: Wrote the docs-site design spec (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-01-docs-site-design.md): VitePress site under docs/site/, ~29 pages, generated tool tables, candid evolution chapter, stale-docs fix …
summary: Docs-site plan must cover the plugin-tool-references test — it asserts tool-surface classification in README/TWINING-REFERENCE tables; the site's tool tables need the same guard or generation
